messages:
maya: Heads-up — Acme reported a sustained surge of 504s starting ~08:10 UTC during large embed batches (1000+ items). They also saw duplicate billing events. Ticket #AC-827 attached.

alan: digging in. do we have p95/p99 for ingress at that window?

kevin: I can see many upstream keepalive resets on edge-frontend around 08:09-08:15. logs: `http2: stream reset: CANCEL` and a lot of `read tcp: connection reset by peer`.

lisa: Billing looking at duplicate invoice lines for same request IDs — can confirm retries landed twice for a subset of requests. saving examples.

maya: @jack_acme can you confirm SDK version and whether client had custom retry logic?

jack_acme: using node-sdk v1.8.2, default retries. batch pipeline retries on 5xx enabled. we saw ~30% of requests return 504 then succeed after retry, but we got charged twice for completed tokens.

srebot: Incident detected: high-504-rate on hosted-ingress (edge-eu-west). Threshold exceeded at 2026-03-12T08:10:12Z.

alan: probable hypothesis: client-side retry + connection keepalive timeout caused duplicate processing because server accepted but response dropped. need repro steps.

kevin: repro plan: 1) send large embed batch (~1000 small docs) over HTTP/2 with default keepalive 60s; 2) artificially cut TCP from edge to runtime after request accepted but before response fully flushed; 3) observe server commit vs response ack.

maya: onboarding notes for Acme: they use multiplexed streams over one HTTP/2 connection and a custom small window size in the SDK.

lisa: temporary mitigation: we'll issue a billing credit for duplicated token charges while we investigate. I'll queue it once we have the request IDs.

alan: quick mitigation for customers: recommend SDK bump to v1.9.0 which adds idempotency token header `X-Redwood-Idempotency` for embed/batch endpoints. also suggest setting maxRetries=2 and enabling per-request idempotency on batch jobs.

jack_acme: can you share a config patch for our pipeline? we want minimal changes.

kevin: snippet to add to Node SDK client: ```js
const client = new RedwoodClient({
  idempotency: true,
  maxRetries: 2,
  http2WindowSize: 65535 // revert any custom tiny window
});
```

maya: ops checklist: 1) correlate request IDs from Acme (they provided 10 examples) -> matched in edge logs; 2) check runtime commit logs for duplicate processing -> kevin doing that; 3) billing credit -> lisa; 4) push SDK recommendation + KB article -> maya.

kevin: runtime check: for 3 of 10 examples, runtime shows model output generated and tokens emitted but edge connection closed before final chunk ack; server marked as success in traces but response never delivered back to client; retry caused second run -> duplicate bill.

alan: root cause likely: (1) edge TCP resets under backpressure during large parallel batches + (2) clients retrying without idempotency tokens. fix: edge queuing smoothing + encourage idempotency.

lisa: billing credit created for Acme — pending manual approval (ref BL-442). I'll confirm when posted.

maya: communication plan: send Acme a short note: cause summary, temporary credit, steps to mitigate on their side, timeline for edge smoothing. I'll draft now.

jack_acme: thanks. can you also let us know ETA for edge smoothing? it's impacting nightly batch jobs.

alan: short-term ETA: rolling config change to edge ingress (increase keepalive + queue smoothing) scheduled in 2h with a 10m canary. will monitor 504 rate.

kevin: I'll instrument an extra trace flag for the canary to capture stream reset reasons and dump small trace samples to the incident channel.

maya: thanks team. I'll post status updates to Acme after canary completes. :thumbsup:

srebot: Deploy scheduled: edge-ingress-keepalive-and-queue-smoothing at 2026-03-12T10:15:00Z (canary).
